paper.title: TabPFN prior fitting (Section 4, Appendix): 12-layer Transformer, d=512

note: Architecture (12 layers, d_model 512, 4 heads, FFN 1024), up to 100 features, 10 classes and 1024 samples follow the paper; the paper's prior is a richer SCM/BNN mixture with feature warping, categorical features and missing values (Appendix C) and was trained for ~20 hours on 8 GPUs. Step count, batch size and LR here are assumptions. Evaluation in the paper is on 30 OpenML-CC18 datasets (<=1000 samples, <=100 numerical features, <=10 classes) with ROC AUC.
